tickets.title: Prepare irregular business income and owner draw planning worksheet
tickets.text: Prepare a planning worksheet for Darian Nettlewhisk’s Copper Firefly Studio LLC that separates household draws, tax set-asides, and business operating reserves. Account for uneven retainer income and workshop payments.
tickets.evidence: Darian asked for a planning worksheet that separates household draws, tax set-asides, and business operating reserves because retainer income and workshop payments will not arrive evenly. The agreed follow-up is to provide that worksheet by 2024-10-25.

tickets.title: Set up business bookkeeping and CPA coordination
tickets.text: Establish a chart of accounts, recurring bookkeeping schedule, and coordination format for Copper Firefly Studio LLC. Prepare the materials for Linnea Thimblefern of Paper Otter Tax to review estimated tax cash needs.
tickets.evidence: For business books and the CPA handoff, the launch of Copper Firefly Studio LLC requires a chart of accounts, recurring bookkeeping schedule, and coordination format for Linnea to review estimated tax cash needs.

tickets.title: Address business liability and income protection coverage
tickets.text: Address Copper Firefly Studio LLC’s missing professional liability policy and Darian Nettlewhisk’s disability coverage, which was tied to his prior employer benefits.
tickets.evidence: the pre-meeting coverage review found that Copper Firefly Studio LLC has no professional liability policy on file and that Darian’s disability coverage was tied to his prior employer benefits. The agreed follow-up is to address those coverage items by 2024-11-01.
